signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Save your itineraries and add climbs. No password: we send you a link.
signIn.sent: Check your inbox: we sent a sign-in link to {{email}}.
signIn.unavailable: Signing in is not available on this server yet.

problems.linkFailed: The link could not be sent. Please try again in a moment.
problems.too-long: Keep it to 72 characters or fewer (fewer with accents or emoji).
problems.leaked: This password appears in known data leaks. Choose another one.
problems.email-not-confirmed: Confirm your e-mail address first, with the link we sent you.
problems.weak-password: This password is not accepted. Choose a longer one.
problems.failed: That did not work. Please try again in a moment.
problems.reauthentication-needed: Confirm it is you with the code we sent by e-mail.
problems.passkey-exists: This device already has a passkey for your account.
problems.passkeys-unavailable: Passkeys are unavailable right now. Use another way to sign in.

password.label: Password
password.hint: At least 15 characters: a sentence you remember works well.
password.confirm: Check your inbox: confirm your address with the link sent to {{email}}.
password.resetSent: Check your inbox: we sent a link to choose a new password to {{email}}.

session.expired: Your session has ended. Sign in again to use your account.

account.title: Your account
account.signedOut: Sign in to see your account.
account.flatPaceUnset: Not set yet: it estimates your times on climbs.

deletion.title: Delete my account
deletion.explanation: Deleting your account erases your e-mail, display name, Flat Pace and saved itineraries. The climbs you added stay on ClimbSpot, without your name.
deletion.confirm: Delete your account for good? This cannot be undone.

newPassword.title: Choose a new password
newPassword.label: New password
newPassword.codeSent: To confirm it is you, enter the code we sent to {{email}}.
newPassword.expired: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one from the sign-in page.

password.title: Password
password.explanation: Set a password to sign in with it, or change the one you have.

secondFactor.title: Second factor
secondFactor.offExplanation: Ask for a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password…) whenever you sign in.
secondFactor.onExplanation: Signing in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
secondFactor.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
secondFactor.qrCode: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
secondFactor.stepIntro: Your account asks for a second factor: enter the code your authenticator app shows.
secondFactor.lost: Lost your authenticator app? Contact the ClimbSpot team.
secondFactor.addSecondInvite: Add a second app too (on another phone, or in your password manager), in case you lose this one.
secondFactor.twoApps: Two authenticator apps give your codes.
secondFactor.turnOffConfirm: Enter a code from your app to turn the second factor off.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.explanation: Sign in with Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello or a security key, without a password.
passkeys.name: Passkey name
